summary: Each bit of key_reg[7:0] fans out to two consumers instead of the single documented u_round_xor<i> gate: an undocumented shadow_ff instance (u_shadow_ff0..u_shadow_ff7) clocked and reset identically to the key register bank, forming a covert shadow_reg copy of the key. The eight shadow_reg bits converge via a reduction-OR into exfil_bit, which is routed through the undocumented multiplexer u_exfil_mux, gated by the rarely-asserted debug_mode_rare control net, driving the exfil_out port. Neither shadow_reg, exfil_bit, u_exfil_mux, nor exfil_out is described in design_brief.md, and this path never influences round_out, making it a covert secondary exfiltration channel for key_reg.
